images.title: Four dosas and a tip
images.purpose: Show an expression as equal groups plus a separate extra, with its two terms.
images.composition: Four plates in a row, a gap, then one small tip coin, with a bracket under each part and the expression centred below.
exact_structure: Four identical circular plates in a row, dark outline, light teal #0072B2 fill, each marked ₹23.
A wider gap, then one amber #E69F00 coin marked ₹5 and labelled Tip.
Under the four plates a grey #6B7280 bracket labelled 4 × 23.
Under the coin a grey bracket labelled 5.
rejection: the tip coin inside the group of plates
images.takeaway: Equal groups form one term and the extra is a second term.
images.description: Four ₹23 plates and a separate ₹5 tip, labelled as the two terms of 4 × 23 + 5.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text on equal groups plus extras.
images.teaching_notes: Point to each bracket and say which term it is.

image_decisions.why: Naming the two terms from a picture shows how a story becomes an expression.
